description: Audit, improve, and compress every skill in the repo using live research. Load when the user asks to improve skills, audit the skill library, upgrade existing skills, refresh with new research, do a skill health check, or says "improve all skills", "update the skill library", "skill audit", or "run an improvement pass". Applies live domain research, fixes structural gaps, checks for skill linking opportunities, then rewrites and resizes each skill. Supports TARGETED mode (`TARGET=<skill> [SKIP_RESEARCH=true]`) for single-skill fixes, including learn-from-chat restructure escalations. All skills are in scope including meta skills.
